title: Hard Hat Economics: Finding construction's bright side
summary: In spite of high borrowing costs, rising material prices and labor challenges, nonresidential construction is still seeing momentum driven by surging data center development and record investments in social facilities. Read Dr. Basu’s take on what this means for contractors.
